analogy.rationale: ABCA1/ABCB11/CES1 are transporters and an esterase involved in lipid handling, not classic transcriptional-response drug targets; the closest reference classes are other lipid/cholesterol and nuclear-receptor pathways (LXR, FXR, PPAR, HMGCR) plus P-glycoprotein transport inhibition, but these cells' response to an atherogenesis inhibitor is expected to be weak.
